I can’t reliably give the numeric values without executing this many assignments. If you save the assignments in a file, this script will track them and print the requested `ANSWER:` line:

```python
import re
import sys

values = {}
for name, rhs in re.findall(
    r"\b(TMP|[a-p])\s*<-\s*(TMP|[a-p]|\d+)\s*;",
    sys.stdin.read(),
):
    values[name] = int(rhs) if rhs.isdecimal() else values[rhs]

names = [*map(chr, range(ord("a"), ord("p") + 1)), "TMP"]
print("ANSWER: " + " ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in names))
```
